executionScenarios.name: curate-and-send
executionScenarios.description: Several stories are fetched, rewritten, and the newsletter is sent.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The news source returns four recent story items (title + link + blurb). The email/send call returns a success response.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The run completes without errors and sends one newsletter whose body is built from the fetched stories, with headlines and commentary.

conversation.text:
Build me a daily newsletter called 'The Daily Dragon' with the subtitle 'Top Headlines + Reactions'.
Every day it should pull interesting business, tech, startup and AI news stories, then rewrite them into a punchy, funny newsletter — top headlines with short summaries and reaction-style commentary — and send it out to me.

description: Daily curated news newsletter ('The Daily Dragon') that fetches stories, rewrites them in a punchy reaction style, and sends them out. Sourced from a real build+execute thread (langtracer 3a182a7f). Scoped to a single fetch source and one delivery channel; the capability under test is schedule -> fetch stories -> LLM-rewrite -> deliver.
outcomeExpectations: A Schedule trigger runs the workflow once a day.
News stories are fetched from an external source (an RSS Read or an HTTP Request) rather than being invented by the model.
An LLM rewrites the fetched stories into newsletter content — headlines, short summaries, and reaction-style commentary — based on the fetched items.
The assembled newsletter is delivered (an email/Gmail/SMTP send, or equivalent delivery node).
